User Story Description: As a new user, I want to sign up for a Netflix account so that I can access video content.
As a registered user, I want to log in to my account so that I can use Netflix’s services.
As a user, I want to recover my password so that I can regain access to my account.
As a viewer, I want to search for movies or series so that I can find the content I want to watch.
As a user, I want to play a video from the search results so that I can enjoy my chosen content.
As a parent, I want to set up parental controls so that I can restrict inappropriate content for my children.
As a frequent traveler, I want to download videos for offline viewing so that I can watch them without an internet connection.
As a binge-watcher, I want to enable autoplay for the next episode so that I can continue watching without interruptions.
As a user, I want to adjust playback settings (e.g., subtitles, video quality) so that I can customize my viewing experience.
As a returning viewer, I want to resume watching from where I left off so that I can continue my series seamlessly.
As a subscriber, I want to manage my subscription (upgrade/cancel) so that I can control my membership plan.
As a user, I want to view my watch history so that I can track previously viewed content.
As a user, I want to set reminders for upcoming releases so that I don’t miss new content.
As a parent, I want to monitor my child’s viewing history so that I can ensure age-appropriate content is being watched.
As an account holder, I want to delete my account so that I can permanently stop using the service.
